ferme.name: La ferme
ferme.alt: A sunny farm painted in ink and gouache: a rhino's horn poking up through a field of tall corn, a stubborn mule with baskets refusing the carrots a boy holds out, a count in a red cloak waving from the battlements of a castle on the hill, a dashing cavalier in a big feathered hat and blue cape galloping on a brown pony, a donkey trotting with a boy in a green hat on her back, a bull lying in a row of daisies reading a book covered in stars, a farmer coaxing his horse into its stable, a mother cow with her newborn calf and a shepherd on a hay bale sharing his burger with a white sheepdog beside a wooden fence. The red barn leads to the farmyard, the white paddock gate to the riding ring, the wooden field gates to the fields and the vine arch on the hill to the hillside vineyard; an old tree stump in the middle can be looked at closer, and the white gate at the bottom left leads out to the valley.

doors.label: La basse-cour
doors.hint: Go in through the big red barn door to the farmyard

doors.label: Le manège
doors.hint: Go through the white paddock gate to the riding ring

doors.label: Les champs
doors.hint: Go through the wooden field gates to the fields

doors.label: Le coteau
doors.hint: Walk up the hill and through the vine arch to the hillside vineyard

zooms.label: la souche
zooms.hint: Look closer at the old tree stump

souche.name: La vieille souche
souche.alt: Close-up of the old tree stump in the middle of the farm: a porcelain teapot with a smiling face on a little wooden shelf, a leather saddle on its stand, a cavalry of fluffy pom-pom ponies charging to rescue a lost lamb, a small blank wooden board, a herd of cows marching in line, two children passing a relay baton and a strong ox pulling a plow.

bassecour.name: La basse-cour
bassecour.alt: The farmyard behind the barn: a red barn with a cow peeping out of the hayloft and a black cast-iron cooking range and a steaming pot of soup standing in its doorway, a cow enjoying a foamy brush wash, a goat nibbling a striped chevron sign, a horse lying on a pillow in the stable while a vet gives him his cure, a rooster crowing on top of a giant green glass bottle, a pig snoozing on a huge cushion, a fisherman on a little jetty, a farmer forking a steaming manure heap beside a sunflower, a sheep trying to moo at two surprised cows and chickens paddling in a blue paddling pool. An old tree stump with tiny things on it can be looked at closer, and the open white gate at the bottom right leads back to the farm.

doors.label: La ferme
doors.hint: Go back through the open white gate to the farm

zooms.label: la souche
zooms.hint: Look closer at the tree stump in the farmyard

souchebasse.name: La souche de la basse-cour
souchebasse.alt: Close-up of the farmyard tree stump: a little scientist plotting a single dot on a big graph on an easel, a turkey in a dandy waistcoat and bow tie, a ewe nuzzling her baby lamb, a hen and a duck pecking as a volleyball bounces past, a farm hangar big enough for a tractor, a plane and cows, a wet lamb standing in the water trough and a pan of sizzling bacon on a little stove.

manege.name: Le manège
manege.alt: The riding ring at sunset: a little village of cottages where a goose in a sash is the mayor, cows grazing the pasture while Pa tours it on his tractor, a girl in a helmet at her riding lesson, a girl riding a gray horse bareback and waving, a potter shaping clay into an argyle sock, a palette covered in sequins on a stool, a clown on the barn roof juggling cabbages in front of the full moon, a camel covered in shampoo bubbles, a stubborn mule at the fence, a farmer raising a lamb up in his arms, a dog barking at the postman, a cat digging in dark soil, a dad galloping on a hobby horse and a gentle dinosaur munching hay beside the cows. The white gate at the bottom left leads back to the farm.

doors.label: La ferme
doors.hint: Go back through the white gate to the farm

champs.name: Les champs
champs.alt: The harvest fields: a sheep driving a red tractor among the corn and wheat, a seed sprouting in a little pot on a crate, a farmer proudly holding up a gold medal in his field of sunflowers, a cow mooing at the miller by a windmill, a puppy peering down a stone well, a mouse harvesting a stalk of wheat, a farmer paying his son coins for a basket of apples, a horse fanning itself with a big fan made of hay held in its teeth, a gran peering through a microscope at one tiny grain beside a big wheat sheaf and a cow kneeling to pray in a little fenced meadow full of flowers and butterflies. An old tree stump with tiny things on it can be looked at closer, and the wooden field gate at the bottom left leads back to the farm.

doors.label: La ferme
doors.hint: Go back through the wooden field gate to the farm

zooms.label: la souche
zooms.hint: Look closer at the tree stump in the field

souchechamps.name: La souche des champs
souchechamps.alt: Close-up of the tree stump in the field: a hare chasing a butterfly through a patch of wildflowers, a young colt pulling a cart of golden wheat, a child pressing seeds into the soil while a robin watches, a prize cabbage with a blue rosette, neat rows of sunflowers, a farmer milking a cow into a pail, tall stalks of maize, a few little wooden kegs by a ramp and a tractor giving lambs a tour in its trailer.

coteau.name: Le coteau
coteau.alt: The hillside vineyard: a built-up town of red roofs piled like toy blocks on the far hill, fallow land overrun with poppies and rabbits, a little judge-owl in a white wig holding out a summons over a pile of seeds, a mean farmer with crossed arms in a dead, cracked patch of field turning away a hungry sparrow, a horse yawning hugely as the plowman cuts a long furrow, a young cowboy showing the shiny spur on his boot, a sock standing on a stone plinth like a statue, a villager blowing a trumpet beside his little white villa and a boy scooping gray fertilizer from a sack. An old tree stump with tiny things on it can be looked at closer, and the vine arch at the left leads back to the farm.

doors.label: La ferme
doors.hint: Go back through the vine arch to the farm

zooms.label: la souche
zooms.hint: Look closer at the tree stump in the vineyard

souchecoteau.name: La souche du coteau
souchecoteau.alt: Close-up of the tree stump in the vineyard: grape pickers with baskets piled high with purple grapes, a mole dentist pulling a carrot out of the ground with pliers, two children racing to pick strawberries into baskets while a referee blows his whistle and holds up a hand, a little bank of vines whose grape bunches shake with terrified faces, a little truck driving along neat rows while a farmer in the back sows seeds, and a farmer in a flat cap lifting his lambs into a little wooden lift cage.
